data.rationale: The proposal captures the right procedure in the right order (origin, destination, dates, search, select fares) and names most parameters, but it omits passengers, fare type and passenger details, and it leaves the steps vague ("type or pick", "Done/Search") and the promo code placement unclear, so an automation would need guesswork.
